description: Replace a webhook endpoint's signing secret with a new one. The previous secret stops signing at once - this tool sets no grace period - so deliveries fail the consumer's signature check until it is given the new secret. The endpoint's URL, events and enabled state do not change. Not idempotent: every call issues another secret and drops the previous one. Refused when no endpoint has that id, or when the caller lacks a permission the endpoint's events require. Returns { secret, endpoint }: secret is the NEW secret, returned only here and never again; endpoint is the stored endpoint - its URL, events, enabled state and description - without any secret. To change the URL, events or enabled state, use update_webhook.
name: rotate_webhook_secret
title: Rotate webhook secret
